name: upload_preview
title: Upload Preview
description: Shows a picked image before the form is submitted, and lets the user remove it.

attributes.name: data-upload-preview
attributes.description: Wraps the file input, the image and the remove button.

attributes.name: data-upload-preview-default-image
attributes.description: Image shown after the user removes the picture. The CLI installs a placeholder avatar.svg in your images directory.

attributes.name: data-upload-preview-target
attributes.description: input (the ), image (the ) and removeInput (a hidden input set to true when the picture is removed).

attributes.name: data-upload-preview-action
attributes.description: "previewImage" on the file input (it runs on input); "click->clear" on the remove button.

actions.name: previewImage
actions.description: Shows the selected file in the image and sets removeInput to false.

actions.name: clear
actions.description: Shows the default image and sets removeInput to true.

notes: Your server decides what to do with the removeInput value, e.g. delete the stored picture when it is "true".
